cases.assertion: a connection without tenant/user ownership cannot be registered
an unregistered server or tool cannot be invoked
a tool missing effect, timeout, schema, or idempotency metadata cannot enter the core registry
runtime carries a secret_ref and proxy injects the value only for the configured host
a secret is not injected for a host outside its configured HTTPS allowlist
responses, logs, events, traces, and errors contain no plaintext MCP secret
a user or tenant cannot read or invoke another owner’s connection
disconnect or revoke makes existing lease/token unusable
duplicate connect, disconnect, revoke, and reconnect requests have one observable outcome
old clients remain usable when connection responses add fields
each child has task, parent, agent, session, and tenant scope identifiers
a child cannot read or write another tenant, task, or session
sub_agent cannot perform a write effect unless explicitly authorized
sub_task nesting beyond depth two is rejected with a diagnostic reason
a shared artifact has one writer at a time and never silently overwrites
independent read children may run concurrently within the tenant/task budget
cancelling a parent reaches all active children and prevents new tool calls
duplicate child cancel, timeout, completion, and report events do not duplicate effects
unbounded child fanout is rejected by existing tenant/task active limits
Task, Round, child agent, and tool spans share correlation identifiers without secrets
old clients can read task/result when agent and round fields are added
unknown child or cancellation states are not treated as successful completion
